description: Remove products from the user's MyGroceryPal shopping list, or delete them from their saved items altogether. Takes productIds from list_saved_items. Confirm with the user before removing. Safe to repeat: products already gone are reported in notFoundProductIds and nothing else changes. Needs the user's MyGroceryPal account.

from.description: 'list' takes the products off the shopping list but keeps them saved, with their deal alerts; 'saved' deletes them from the account entirely, list included

name: remove_saved_items
title: Remove items from my list
